en: A yellow postal card from the Museum of Physical Education and Sports in Budapest. The left side shows a round image of a sports medal, labeled with the number 6, and Hungarian and English text about an exposition of sports medals in 1987. On the upper right is a green Hungarian postage stamp depicting a tennis player (W. C. Wingfield) with a trophy and tennis racket, labeled "MAGYAR POSTA" and "WIMBLEDON 1877". There is also a circular commemorative postmark featuring a female athlete and Hungarian text, dated 1987.08.22. Address lines appear on the lower right.
